Order 5‑Page Business Website $2950

Yes. For $2,950 you get a custom‑designed, five‑page website that you own outright. Click Launch and we’ll build, host for $0/month, and hand you the code, content and domain.

How it works for a small business launch

  1. Choose the Launch package on the order page.
  2. Pay a 50 % deposit; we start the design and development.
  3. In about a week you receive a live site with contact forms and basic SEO.
  4. Review the site; we make any final tweaks before launch.
  5. After launch you get 90 days of free care, then optional support plans if you wish.

What you get and the cost

  • Up to 5 pages of custom design (home, about, services, contact, etc.)
  • Fully owned code, content and domain – no hidden fees
  • Hosting on Cloudflare Pages and GitHub at $0/month
  • Contact forms, basic SEO, and a week‑long turnaround
  • 90 days of free post‑launch care; ongoing care optional at $295/month or $595/month
  • Balance due at launch (the remaining 50 %).

FAQ

What happens if I don’t like the design? You can request a free homepage remake first. If you don’t like it, you keep the design and pay nothing for the remake.

Do I have to sign a long‑term contract? No. You own the site outright after the final payment. Ongoing care is optional and can be cancelled any time.

How quickly will my site be live? The Launch package is built in about a week, then you go live immediately on Cloudflare Pages.

Ready to start? Order your 5‑page business website now
